description: Changes quantities in the cart (0 removes the line) and/or the delivery ZIP. If the result has "essentials", mention them once in one sentence with their reason (things the player genuinely needs with this cart, never an upsell push) and add them only if the shopper says yes; never repeat the suggestion. Show the cart, then offer checkout_url: the shopper pays on Padel USA's secure Shopify checkout (Shop Pay, cards, PayPal) and enters the delivery address there. Never ask for payment details in chat.

needs.description: What you learned about the player, so the cart can suggest only what they genuinely need. Pass it on every cart call.

arm_pain.description: They mentioned arm, elbow or wrist pain (tennis elbow).

bag_style.description: Backpack for light carry or commuting; classic racket bag for several rackets, shoes and clothes.

carries_gear.description: They play after work, bring a change of clothes and water, or want to organise their gear.
